Install ntop software

Pick your system, pick what to install, copy the commands, run them once.

Which package do I need?

I want toInstallGuide
See every host and flow on one networkntopngInstall ntopng
Read NetFlow, IPFIX or sFlow from routersntopng + nProbeNetFlow quickstart
Collect flows only, feed another toolnProbeNetFlow quickstart
Monitor 10 to 100 Gbit mirror portsntopng + CentoCento quickstart
Run a gateway with policies and bandwidth controlnEdgenEdge quickstart
Record packets to diskn2diskn2disk product page
Capture traffic on remote hosts or VMsnTapnTap product page
Everything at onceAll ntop packagesPick “All ntop packages” below

Stable is for production. Dev is the nightly build for testing. Ubuntu 26.04 and Debian 13 are dev builds for now.

Choose your system and package

Stable (default)

sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y software-properties-common wget
sudo add-apt-repository -y universe
wget https://packages.ntop.org/apt-stable/24.04/all/apt-ntop-stable.deb
sudo apt install -y ./apt-ntop-stable.deb
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y ntap

Run in the pfSense shell (SSH, or Diagnostics, Command Prompt). Stable and dev use the same packages.

ntopng

Stable (default)

pkg add https://packages.ntop.org/FreeBSD/FreeBSD:16:amd64/latest/ntop-1.0.pkg
pkg update
pkg install ntopng
sysrc redis_enable="YES"
sysrc ntopng_enable="YES"
service redis start
service ntopng start

Dev (newest)

pkg add https://packages.ntop.org/FreeBSD/FreeBSD:16:amd64/latest/ntop-1.0.pkg
pkg update
pkg install ntopng
sysrc redis_enable="YES"

After the install, ntopng runs as a service on https://YOUR-IP:3001. Accept the self-signed certificate. Login: admin / admin.

Mac and Windows: see the ntopng installation guide.

ntopng Community is free. nProbe, Cento, nEdge and n2disk need a license: get a license in the shop.
